decisions.reason: The existing state already requires every automatically awarded ticket to appear on the holder's dashboard and randomly assigned tickets to be registered in totals. The source does not resolve whether no-code mints must generate tickets.

The source establishes dashboard and NFT-attribute presentation for randomly sent commissions, not a concrete FAQ copy change. Its reference to adjusting UI notes for tickets is conditional on unresolved runtime behavior.
The source concerns presentation of commissions from no-code mints and does not change the amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout behavior for code-used referral commissions.
The random-recipient allocation policy remains unchanged. The new requirement concerns displaying an already distributed commission and is owned by commission accounting accuracy.
The source does not request a definite About-page copy revision. Its possible UI-note adjustment concerns unresolved ticket-generation behavior rather than the commission display decision.
Displaying randomly sent commissions does not change how an NFT's referral code is derived, retained, shared, or displayed.

The commission-accounting display decision has no effect on landing-page book-cover placement, size, or visibility.
The source requires randomly distributed commission amounts to appear on dashboard and NFT attributes; it does not change public referral-count statistics on the leaderboard or landing page.
The source does not change hero text, visual emphasis, layout, or presentation.
The source explicitly leaves no-code ticket generation conditional and unresolved, so the candidate's existing VALUE ambiguity remains unchanged. It does not support a concrete MODIFY.
